name: 1S LiPo pouch cell 103454, about 2000 mAh, with protection board and leads
blurb: A rechargeable 3.7 V lithium-polymer battery of about 2000 mAh (10 x 34 x 54 mm) with a protection board and two wire leads, for builds that must run for days.

pins.note: Red lead. 3.0 to 4.2 V depending on charge, not a regulated rail. The cell itself allows 4 A discharge; the 2000 mA here is a cautious figure for the protection board and thin leads of a typical pack, not a datasheet value. Never short it. Check the plug polarity against your charger: it is not standardised.

verify: Body is the maker's maximum envelope of the bare cell: 10.3 x 34.5 x 55 mm, 56 mm with the sealed edge (L1). This is the 103454 size; the shop size 103450 is about 4 mm shorter and a maker drawing for it was not found, so measure the pack you buy (length, width and thickness) and leave 1 mm or more for swelling. No sheet for the pack with protection board was opened: that the board fits inside the 56 mm length, the lead length and the 2000 mA supply limit are assumptions. The leads leave at the tab end (x = 56); their y positions here are the cell's tab positions from the drawing (tabs 15 mm apart, + on the left with the tabs pointing away from you), not measured lead exits. Confirm a protection board is fitted, and the connector type and polarity.
sources: https://eemb.oss-accelerate.aliyuncs.com//uploads/20230310/238a3765db60b3d0c770182b3e44cd4c.pdf (EEMB LP103454 cell specification ZJQM-RD-SPC-H0486, opened and read, pages 3 and 4: T max 10.3, W max 34.5, L max 55, L1 max 56, tab length 10, tab spacing M 15, tab width 4; 2000 mAh nominal, 3.7 V, charge max 2000 mA to 4.2 V, discharge max 4000 mA, cut-off 2.75 V)
